The QCIL ASTER DM Healthcare’s (ASTERDM) Q2 consolidated EBITDA grew 27% YoY to INR 6.6bn, 5% above our estimates; aided by strong performance across clusters.
The QCIL ramp up has been on track with strong YoY EBITDA growth for H1.
ASTERDM completed its merger with Quality Care (QCIL), effective from Q2FY27, making it the third largest healthcare chain by revenue and bed capacity in India.
